text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert: Elevated 5xx rate (~18% errors) observed for requests routed through private-vpc egress -> inference-gateway (gw-prod-priv-a). Auto-detection flagged: 502/504 and timeout spikes since 00:12 UTC. Pager duty page sent.

oncall_nina: On it. Which customers are impacted? any public endpoints?

incident-bot: Impacted routes: /v1/generate (hosted behind private VPCs). Sample customer IDs: cust-rc, cust-b2b1, cust-mlp. Error spike started 00:12, trending up. Recent metric: 18% 5xx over 5m.

cs_lee: Cust-rc just opened a support ticket, they see 502s from our API and are customer-facing. They reported from APAC region.

sre_jake: Checking gateway logs now. Running `kubectl logs -n infra gateway-priv-a --since=15m` to surface errors.

eng_runtime_sam: Could be SNAT/NAT exhaustion or security group rejecting ephemeral ports. We saw similar last month.

netops_ali: Starting quick health checks on NAT appliance and peering. `aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=attachment.instance-owner-id,Values=network-appliance` and `ss -s` on NAT host.

sre_jake: Paste from gateway log: ```
[00:12:34] upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers
[00:12:34] 502 from upstream: connection reset by peer
[00:13:05] timeout waiting for response from upstream
```

netops_ali: Traceroute from gateway to model-serving endpoints shows intermittent `* * *` around 10.20.3.1 (transit NAT). Running `tcpdump -nni eth0 port 443 and host model-backend` to check resets.

oncall_nina: I’m going to page netops. @netops_ali you have the handoff. If NAT is flapping we need fallback path.

netops_ali: Confirmed high conntrack table usage on nat-host-12: `conntrack -S` shows entries ~1.9M (max 2M). Ephemeral port usage near exhaustion. I can see大量 of TIME_WAIT from our inference host pool.

eng_runtime_sam: Can we short-term increase conntrack or rotate NAT host? Also check if SGs were changed — sometimes a deploy tightened egress SGs and forced upstream reset.

ops-bot: Deploy: firewall-rollout-v2 succeeded at 23:58 UTC (by infra-ci). Related change: tightened outbound SGs for default-inference-subnet to allow only 443 to model-backend (should be fine).

sre_jake: Running `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=4000000` on nat-host-12 to buy time. Also increasing ephemeral port range: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="15000 61000"`.

netops_ali: Doing that now. conntrack max updated, ephemeral range widened. Monitoring conntrack counters...

oncall_nina: Any risk to in-flight requests when changing sysctls?

netops_ali: Minimal. No restart. Should help new connections. Early sign: 5xx rate down to 9% after 60s, but still above baseline.

eng_runtime_sam: Suggest also enabling prefix caching on the gateway to reduce new upstream connections for similar requests — will patch config for route /v1/generate to cache prefixes for 5s. Pushing via `kubectl apply -f gateway-cache-patch.yaml`.

deploy-bot: Deployment gateway-cache-patch v1.2 started. Rolling update across 3 pods.

sre_jake: Meanwhile I see some TCP RSTs originating from model-backend's firewall to our NAT IPs — suspicious. Checking peering route tables.

netops_ali: Peering looks stable, but I found an ACL on the target VPC that started rejecting >64k source ports due to a misinterpreted rule (range mismatch). That would drop asymmetric replies for high ephemeral port numbers. I’m opening a temporary allow rule to widen source port range.

cs_lee: Communicating update to Cust-rc that we are investigating and have mitigations in progress. They asked for ETA.

oncall_nina: ETA?

netops_ali: After immediate ACL relax + conntrack bump + cache patch, errors dropped to ~2% in last 3m. I’ll keep monitoring for 20m. Preliminary root cause: overly restrictive firewall/ACL on peer VPC that blocked high ephemeral port ranges combined with conntrack saturation causing upstream resets/timeouts.

eng_runtime_sam: We'll keep cache and increase connection reuse timeout on gateway to reduce new TCP churn. Follow-up action: add automated test for ephemeral port acceptance on peered VPCs during infra rollouts.

oncall_nina: Okay — moving to monitoring state. Will keep this thread open for 60m then do handoff to postmortem channel. @netops_ali, @eng_runtime_sam please add your notes for RCA.

netops_ali: Noted. Adding tags to incident system: root_cause: peering-acl-ephemeral-port, mitigation: conntrack-scale + acl-relax + cache, customers: cust-rc,cust-b2b1,cust-mlp.

sre_jake: Captured commands and timestamps to incident log. Will escalate to change review to prevent future firewall rules that restrict ephemeral port ranges.

cs_lee: Told cust-rc we restored service and will follow up with RCA within 24h. They appreciated the prompt updates.

incident-bot: P1 -> monitoring. If error >5% re-escalate.

oncall_nina: Handing off to netops for cleanup and to eng for follow-up. Thanks everyone :heart:

ops-bot: Handoff recorded. Incident ticket: INC-2142000000. Postmortem scheduled: 24h review in #postmortems.
